This directory contains the minimal subset of the HKU-MARS `ikd-Tree`
implementation used by this project.

Retained files:
- `ikd_Tree.h`
- `ikd_Tree.cpp`

Source repository originally imported under:
- `ikd-tree-repo/ikd-Tree/`

The project build is wired against this trimmed directory so the rest of the
upstream demo, document, and example files are not required for compilation.
